summary: John's 4th-great-grandfather; Irish immigrant of 1848 who lived at Elmira, NY, then ran a restaurant in Plymouth.
bio: Thomas Connole and his wife Honora Dwyre were 'natives of Ireland, who came to America in 1848, settling in the State of New York' (Bradsby 1893). Their children Mary (1850) and John F. (9 Mar 1853) were born at Elmira, and Honora 'Nora' in Plymouth Twp about 1855. FamilySearch gives him a birth in 1815 in 'County Clare' (from the Find a Grave index only - speculative; Connole is a north Clare surname, found mainly in Clare, Galway and Cork per John Grenham). He ran a restaurant in Plymouth, which John F. briefly managed after 1878. After Honora died (FamilySearch says at Elmira, speculative) he married Anastasia (Boney) Heffernan, widow of Richard Heffernan; this was after 1860, when she was still listed as Heffernan. He died in 1878 at Plymouth and was buried at St. Mary's, Hanover Twp. (FamilySearch). The family was not found in the full 1860 Elmira city census transcription.
